text:
lena: Medivex just sent an RFI, asking for a capability matrix, KMS/HSM details, embedding perf for 400+ qps, and POC pricing. 72h turnaround requested. PDF: <https://medivex-share/rfis/medivex_rfi_2026.pdf>
marco: I can draft the capmatrix and perf appendix. Will reuse our standard embed bench results but need to confirm numbers for Dedicated x6.
priya: Ill take the security answers (KMS/HSM + key custody) and the cert list. Quick note: they care about EU data residency and FedRAMP status.
lena: EU residency yes. Also they asked for a diagram of key flow and confirmation we don't export keys.
priya: Suggested wording: "Redwood Private supports customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) and external HSMs (AWS CloudHSM, on-prem HSM via KMIP/PKCS#11). Customer keys remain under customer control; Redwood components never export raw key material." Can anyone add a one-line FedRAMP status?
legal: Were currently FedRAMP Ready (contract stage) for certain gov customers; prefer: "FedRAMP authorization in progress; can provide timeline under NDA."
marco: Perf numbers from latest internal run on x6-rtu, model open-embed-3, seq=256: p95 ~140ms at 400 qps, avg ~95ms. I'll phrase as "typical observed" with caveats.
lena: Medivex wants a POC pricing table: 2-week pilot (smoke), 3-month POC (bench + integration). Priya any guidance on discounts?
priya: We can offer pilot at $2k flat for 2 weeks (limited tokens), 3-month POC we usually do reserved credits with 30% off list on first 3 months, min commit $15k/month for Dedicated. PAYG fallback per-embed unit: $0.0085 per embed (1k-unit). Note: internal finance may adjust.
ops-bot: Attached files: https://files.redwood/team/rfipacks/medivex/embed-bench-179888.csv, https://files.redwood/team/rfipacks/medivex/capmatrix-base.xlsx :white_check_mark:
marco: I'll include a short appendix showing the bench command and raw numbers. Sample log:
```
$ run_bench --model open-embed-3 --qps 400 --seq 256
qps: 400
95th latency: 140.3ms
avg latency: 95.1ms
errors: 0
```
lena: Action items: marco: capmatrix + perf appendix (today), priya: security answers + cert list + key-flow diagram (today), legal: FedRAMP phrasing + export control note (EOD). Ill assemble and do final QA.
priya: Also note: for EU residency we can deploy Private in customer VPC (EU region) or offer Hosted with data-at-rest in EU (subject to contract).
legal: Add export control line: "We restrict exports per US export control laws; specific controls provided during contracting."
marco: Plan to upload draft pack to outgoing when ready: https://files.redwood/outgoing/medivex/rfi_pack_medivex_v1.zip
lena: Target send time: tomorrow 9am CET. If anyone hits a blocker ping here or DM. :rocket: 
(threads end)
